QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`... With the define set, it expands to `member` and the name is the bare field.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains both branches: without the define consumers see the renamed `private_` members, and with it defined they see the plain names. It also frames this as library code versus external application code.
